**Samira Hurem** (born 14 November 1972) is a Bosnian professional [football manager](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manager_\(association_football\) "Manager \(association football\)") and former [player](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Football_player "Football player"), best known for managing [Bosnian Women's Premier League](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosnia_and_Herzegovina_Women's_Premier_League "Bosnia and Herzegovina Women's Premier League") club [SFK 2000](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SFK_2000 "SFK 2000") from 2010 to 2025. She was also the manager of the [Bosnia and Herzegovina women's national team](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosnia_and_Herzegovina_women's_national_football_team "Bosnia and Herzegovina women's national football team") from 2011 until 2024.
Hurem is Bosnia and Herzegovina's most successful women's football manager, having won more trophies than any other manager in the history of Bosnian women's football.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samira_Hurem#cite_note-1)
